subject: reasoning
question:
By interchanging the given two signs which of the following equation will be correct?

+ and ÷

I. 4 ÷ 2 + 1 - 8 × 3 = - 10

II. 18 ÷ 2 - 8 + 4 × 3 = 14
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4671232025562bc3ba9a781319d633acf8cd8e78dc8e96912cd7564a7df4717d.png] 

I. Given equation : 4 ÷ 2 + 1 - 8 × 3 = - 10

After interchanging the given two symbols + and ÷ the equation is as follows : 4 + 2 ÷ 1 - 8 × 3 = - 10

⇒ 4 + __**2 ÷ 1**__ - 8 × 3 = - 10

⇒ </sp
